name: d1_rader
description: Rader prime->cyclic conv sized by N-1: UNPADDED conv 65536=[4,64,64,4] at N=65537 (two-layer radix-64 = fused radix-8 pair through an 8 KB L1 tile; FUSED MID PASS runs fwd-last butterfly + kernel multiply + inv-first butterfly in one pass -- 7 M-length passes, spectrum never materialized), unpadded 1020=[4,3,5,17] at 1021 (AVX-512 two-half radix-17, scatter-fused exit, paired-p full-lane radix-5), CRT codelets Z12=Z4xZ3 / Z30=Z2xZ3xZ5 at 13/31 (Agarwal-Cooley) with ACROSS-BATCH SoA: 8 transforms per zmm, transpose only at entry/exit; pad 256 at 127; split-complex Stockham core (from d1_bluestein), X[0] free from conv DC; fused map chain keeps state in conv order (gather o scatter = index reversal), Newton rsqrt/rcp map (no divider) in every vector chain exit
